slot: Your question, plus the daily report
summary: The S&P 500 fell to 7,683.69 today, down 0.77%, as rising oil prices and surging Treasury yields (the interest rate on 10-year US government bonds hit 5.24%) squeezed stocks broadly. Gold dropped 3.83% and silver fell 4.82%, both hit hard by the rising yields, which make gold less attractive compared to bonds that now pay more. The US-Iran standoff is driving oil higher and bonds lower, a combination that pressures the whole market. Key data this week includes Core PCE (the Fed's preferred inflation gauge) on Wednesday and jobs numbers Friday, both of which could move markets sharply.
